name: Four Weeks to Stardom
source:
Step into the shoes of a young trainee determined to make her debut in the competitive entertainment industry. Train her skills, build her reputation, and navigate the challenges of idol life as she works toward stardom  alongside her manager Hyun, her bodyguard Geunho, and her childhood friend Sejun.

[From [url=https://daintylovegames.itch.io/4-weeks-to-stardom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
化身一名立志在竞争残酷的演艺圈顺利出道的年轻练习生。磨砺舞台技艺、积累人气口碑，在经纪人贤、保镖根浩以及青梅竹马世俊的陪伴下克服偶像生涯的重重挑战，一步步迈向璀璨星途吧。

[摘自[url=https://daintylovegames.itch.io/4-weeks-to-stardom]itch.io[/url]]
